results.name: extrinsic component of cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane

definition.text: The component of a plasma membrane consisting of gene products and protein complexes that are loosely bound to its cytoplasmic surface, but not integrated into the hydrophobic region.

results.comment: Consider also annotating to 'cell cortex ; GO:0005938'.

extrinsic to internal side of plasma membrane
